title: narrative.hints_fix/1
description: data/narrative/hints_fix.json: corrected tutorial hint lines for ui/data/reads.json (UI owns that file; Narrative owns the text). Keys are beat.variant. Version field: schema. Policy: closed except keys starting with an underscore. Cross-references (every key is a hint that exists in reads.json, its beat is one of reads.json beat_ids) and a length warning (about ten words, over twelve warns) are checked by tools/lib/xref.js (hints-fix-key, hints-fix-length).
